_doc: Swimming in the built world, from the keys: the player walks into Lark Pool from its west shore (the water agent's (170, 2492), heading east), wades, floats and swims out, filmed from its right; then again holding Shift, a hard stroke once afloat. Compatibility, on the built terrain, at a fixed 60 fps: xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x720x24' godot --path game --audio-driver Dummy --resolution 1280x720 --rendering-driver opengl3 --fixed-fps 60 -- --capture=tools/capture/plans/swim.json --out=<dir>
